dct_title_s: IRC Ethiopia ECHO Funded Emergency Responses 31 August 2017 Update
dct_description_sm: IRC’s GIS unit created this database to allow for a more sustained approach to producing relevant mapping products and geospatial analysis for regions undergoing emergencies, and will fill gaps in information sharing and management between ECHO, IRC, and other implementing partners during emergency response. IRC’s GIS services provide ECHO/Ethiopia with the information and analysis required to monitor the evolution of project / program results and to track project and program impacts across implementing agencies and geographic locations. This dataset contains boundaries of Ethiopian administrative Woredas which are roughly consistent with the actual administrative boundaries for the year 2017.The Woreda boundary contains attribute data (implementing Partners, Situation and Sector Fields) for IRC Ethiopia ECHO Funded ERM IV Emergency Responses as of 31 August 2017
